document: Riftbound: Origins Card Errata（官方英文版）

entries.name: Ava Achiever
entries.updated: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand, ignoring its cost. If it’s a unit, play it here.
entries.printed: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand here, ignoring its cost.

entries.name: Baited Hook
entries.updated: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
entries.printed: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

entries.name: Blind Fury
entries.updated:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
entries.printed:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

entries.name: Clockwork Keeper
entries.updated:
You may pay [C] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, draw 1.
entries.printed: As you play me, you may pay [C] as an additional cost. If you do, draw 1.

entries.name: Convergent Mutation
entries.updated:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit. This turn, increase its Might to the Might of another friendly unit.
entries.printed:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit. Increase its Might until it equals the Might of another friendly unit.

entries.name: Dark Child - Starter
entries.updated: At the end of your turn, ready up to 2 runes.
entries.printed: At the end of your turn, ready 2 runes.

entries.name: Dazzling Aurora
entries.updated: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit and banish it. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.
entries.printed: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.

entries.name: Disintegrate
entries.updated:
Action (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, do this: draw 1.
entries.printed:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, draw 1.

entries.name: Dragon's Rage
entries.updated: Move an enemy unit. Then do this: Choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
entries.printed: Move an enemy unit. Then choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

entries.name: Dune Drake
entries.updated: When I attack, give me +2 [M] this turn if there is a ready enemy unit here.
entries.printed: When I attack, give me +2 [M] if there is a ready enemy unit here.

entries.name: Highlander
entries.updated:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
entries.printed:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit. The next time it dies this turn, recall it exhausted instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

entries.name: Karma, Channeler
entries.updated:
[Vision] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
When you recycle one or more cards to your Main Deck, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 [M] buff. Runes aren't cards.)
entries.printed:
[Vision] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 [M] buff. Runes aren't cards.)

entries.name: Kinkou Monk
entries.updated: When you play me, buff up to two other friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 [M] buff.)
entries.printed: When you play me, buff two other friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 [M] buff.)

entries.name: Nocturne, Horrifying
entries.updated:
[Ganking] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
As you look at or reveal me from the top of your deck, you may banish me. If you do, you may play me for [A].
entries.printed:
[Ganking] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
When you look at cards from the top of your deck (and don't draw them) and see me, you may play me for [A].

entries.name: Pack of Wonders
entries.updated: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or facedown card to its owner's hand.
entries.printed: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or [Hidden] card to its owner's hand.

entries.name: Portal Rescue
entries.updated:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Banish a friendly unit, then its owner plays it to their base, ignoring its cost.
entries.printed:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Banish a friendly unit, then play it to base, ignoring its cost.
Note: Text only differs for English version of the card
entries.note: Note: Text only differs for English version of the card

entries.name: Promising Future
entries.updated: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs. (They must still pay Power costs.)
entries.printed: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, chooses one, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs. (They must still pay Power costs.)

entries.name: Ravenborn Tome
entries.updated: [E]: The next spell you play this turn deals 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)
entries.printed: [E]: The next spell you play deals 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)

entries.name: Salvage
entries.updated:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
You may kill up to one gear. Draw 1.
entries.printed:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
You may kill a gear. Draw 1.

entries.name: Sigil of the Storm
entries.updated: When you conquer here, you must recycle one of your runes. (This doesn’t choose anything.)
entries.printed: When you conquer here, recycle one of your runes.

entries.name: Sona, Harmonious
entries.updated: At the end of your turn, if I'm at a battlefield, ready up to 4 friendly runes.
entries.printed: While I'm at a battlefield, ready 4 friendly runes at the end of your turn.

entries.name: Targon's Peak
entries.updated: When you conquer here, ready up to 2 runes at the end of this turn.
entries.printed: When you conquer here, ready 2 runes at the end of this turn.

entries.name: Teemo, Strategist
entries.updated:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
When I defend, choose an enemy unit here and reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to that unit for each card with [Hidden] revealed this way, then recycle the revealed cards.
entries.printed:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
When I defend or I'm played from [Hidden], reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to an enemy unit here for each card with [Hidden], then recycle them.

entries.name: The Boss
entries.updated:
If a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C], exhaust me, and spend its buff to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
When you conquer, ready me.
entries.printed:
When a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C] and exhaust me to spend its buff and recall it exhausted instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
When you conquer, ready me.

entries.name: The Dreaming Tree
entries.updated: When a player chooses a friendly unit here with a spell for the first time each turn, they draw 1.
entries.printed: The first time you choose a friendly unit with a spell here each turn, draw 1.

entries.name: The Syren
entries.updated: [1], [E]: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to its base.
entries.printed:
[1], [E]: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to your base.
Note: Text only differs for English version of the card
entries.note: Note: Text only differs for English version of the card

entries.name: Tideturner
entries.updated:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
When you play me, you may choose a unit you control at another location. Move me to its location and it to my original location.
entries.printed:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
When you play me, you may choose a friendly unit. Move me to its location and it to my original location.

entries.name: Unforgiven
entries.updated: [2], [E]: Move a friendly unit to or from its base.
entries.printed:
[2], [E]: Move a friendly unit to or from your base.
Note: Text only differs for English version of the card
entries.note: Note: Text only differs for English version of the card

entries.name: Unlicensed Armory
entries.updated: Discard 1, [E]: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, you may pay [C] to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
entries.printed: Discard 1, [E]: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it dies this turn, you may pay [C] to recall it exhausted instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

entries.name: Void Gate
entries.updated: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here. (Each instance of damage the spell deals to a unit here is increased by 1.)
entries.printed: Spells and abilities affecting units here each deal 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)

entries.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
entries.updated:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
If a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Heal that unit, exhaust it, and recall it. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
entries.printed:
[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)
The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Recall that unit exhausted. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
